scoring.title: How are points earned?
scoring.subtitle: Choose a play style and customize it to your liking
scoring.configSubtitle: Adjust the values to your liking. You can change the style at any time.
scoring.tip: If this is your first time, we recommend the Predictor style. It is the most fun and balanced.
scoring.multiplierOn: Enabled — points increase in later rounds, giving players who started poorly a chance to climb back.
scoring.multiplierOff: Disabled — points are the same in all phases.
scoring.extraTimeDefault: Only the result at the end of the second half counts, no extra time or penalties (recommended). You can change this in advanced options.
scoring.extraTimeGlobalDesc: Count the result including extra time (no penalties)
scoring.scalingSubLabel: Disable to customize phase by phase

CUMULATIVE.name: Predictor
CUMULATIVE.description: Earn points for getting the result, each team's goals, and the goal difference right. The more you get right, the more you score!
CUMULATIVE.example: If you say 3-1 and it's 2-1 → Result ✓ (5pts) + Away goals ✓ (2pts) = 7pts

BASIC.name: All or Nothing
BASIC.description: Simple and straightforward: you only earn points for the exact score. Points are worth more in advanced rounds.

SIMPLE.name: Strategist
SIMPLE.description: No match scores. In groups you order teams by position. In knockouts you pick who advances.
SIMPLE.example: 1st Argentina, 2nd France → 10pts for each correct position!

CUSTOM.name: Custom
CUSTOM.description: Full control: configure each phase, each criterion, and each point value to your needs.

advancedRules.title: Advanced Rules
advancedRules.subtitle: Optional settings to customize the experience
advancedRules.extraTimeDesc: Count extra-time goals in knockout rounds (penalties not included).
advancedRules.scalingDesc: Points are worth more in advanced tournament phases. Each phase has a multiplier.
advancedRules.phaseScalingDesc: Points are worth more in advanced tournament phases.
advancedRules.offExplanation: Only the 90-minute result counts. If you predict 1-1 and the match ends 1-1 (but extra time finishes 2-1), your prediction is correct.
advancedRules.onExplanation: The final result including extra time counts. If you predict 1-1 but the match finishes 2-1 in extra time, your prediction is wrong.
advancedRules.noAdvancedNeeded: The current configuration does not require advanced settings. You may continue.
advancedRules.note: These settings are optional. The default values work well for most pools.
